fields.label: Call
fields.description: The call these recordings and transcripts belong to.

fields.label: Transcript Source
fields.description: The producer of the text - the calling service, or a transcription service run over the recording afterwards.

fields.label: Summary
fields.description: The provider's own one-line account of the call, where it gives one.

fields.label: Transcript
fields.description: The readable transcript of the call.

fields.label: Segments
fields.description: The transcript broken into turns, with who spoke and when, where the provider supplies it.

fields.label: Raw Payload
fields.description: The provider's transcript exactly as it arrived, kept so the text can be rebuilt without transcribing the call again.

fields.label: Recording State
fields.description: Whether the audio is held, expected, not available, or given up on.

fields.label: Recording File
fields.description: Our own copy of the call audio.

fields.label: Producer's URL
fields.description: The provider's own address for the audio. Kept only so a failed download can be retried; audio is never played from here.

fields.label: Fetch Attempts
fields.description: The number of times the audio has been asked for.

fields.label: Next Attempt At
fields.description: When the next download will be attempted.

fields.label: Last Fetch Error
fields.description: Why the last download attempt failed.
